topic: Among case-control genetic association studies, is the IL17F rs763780 heterozygote associated with rheumatoid arthritis case status relative to the study's common homozygote?

pico.population: Rheumatoid arthritis cases and healthy controls

targets.comparison: IL17F rs763780 heterozygote versus the source-reported common homozygote
targets.population_or_subgroup: Rheumatoid arthritis cases and healthy controls

timepoint_policy.rule: Use the genotype distribution reported for the study case and control samples; preserve the source's nucleotide nomenclature.

primary_analysis_spec.outcome_group: Rheumatoid arthritis odds for IL17F rs763780 heterozygote versus source-common homozygote
selection_rules: Select one complete case/control rs763780 genotype distribution when it compares a heterozygote with the source-reported common homozygote and provides calculator-complete counts.
Preserve source nucleotide labels; selection is based on rsid and genotype role, not an assumed universal A/G or T/C label.
Do not use target-review forest estimates or source studies without a complete genotype distribution for this contrast.
Select at most one eligible effect per independent study for this analysis.
Timepoint eligibility: Use the genotype distribution reported for the study case and control samples; preserve the source's nucleotide nomenclature.
